title: Russia Warns UK It Is 'Playing With Fire' Over NATO Infrastructure Threats
detail: Russia issued a sharp warning to the United Kingdom, accusing it of 'playing with fire' following reports that CIA Director Ratcliffe had warned the Kremlin not to attack NATO infrastructure. The warning comes amid escalating Russia-UK tensions over British support for Ukraine, and reflects growing alarm in Moscow over Western coordination on deterrence messaging.

media.caption: Russia warns UK over NATO infrastructure threats amid Ukraine tensions
